name: Sun Cleric: Sun Stride frees the caster from Dazed (#9835)
contract: Sun Stride 680700 reads 'Increases your movement speed by $s2% for $d. Also frees the caster from slows and roots.' Its mechanic immunities are root (7) and snare (11). Dazed 1604 is a SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED slow whose spell and effect mechanic are MECHANIC_DAZE (27), so the snare immunity alone left it in place. Casting Sun Stride while Dazed must start the stride and remove Dazed.
